description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for git commit functionality, covering various scenarios such as commit amendments, message specifications, author and date overrides, signing off, partial commits, and conflicts handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and validates the outcome.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands expected to fail and verifies they do.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the output or files and asserts presence.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to standard output or files for test setup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Asserts that the given output or file is empty.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock used for timestamping in tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified message and files for test setup.

methods.name: test_commit_message
methods.description: Validates the commit message of a specific commit.
